method: Exact native one-load/NOP difference plus independently decoded wait position; no K4 observation input.

records.formula: L_conditional = q + (Pload-Pnop); NOP slope matches q+23+6/16; final unrolled suffix differs but is byte-identical between pair.
records.scope: Single LDTM; 4KiB register payload/warp, initialized TMEM, native RAW address feedback. One/four active warps crosschecked. Not a universal load latency or full K4 phase cost.
assumptions: Identical nonload bytes and executed counts, verified by NCU/native patch audit.
Load-specific WB0 is first waited by LOP3 at native q=2; no intervening producer or outstanding older WB0 in the serialized chain.
This is ready-endpoint conditional calibration, distinct from throughput. K4 grouping/queue and address-phase applicability remain explicit.
